frame_based_filtering.value: Forward only valid frames based on destination addresses
frame_based_filtering.test_hint: Send frames with invalid destination addresses to verify they are not forwarded.
frame_based_filtering.source_quote: Frame based filtering is done such that the receiving End System will only forward valid frames to a communication or a SAP port.

Communication Ports.no_ip_fragmentation_for_sampling_com_por: less than or equal to the payload size of the associated Virtual Link

Configuration Management.configuration_file_consistency: All configuration files must be identical across all switches in the network

network_data_element_byte_order_requirem.value: must have well-defined bit and byte order for network independence
network_data_element_byte_order_requirem.test_hint: Send frames with data elements using incorrect or undefined byte order encoding
network_data_element_byte_order_requirem.source_quote: These data types have a well-defined bit and byte order that enables applications to send and receive a data element via the network regardless of the native bit or byte order of the host processors u

maximum_technological_latency_in_transmi.test_hint: Generate frames with delays exceeding 150 μs to test if the system enforces the latency constraint.
maximum_technological_latency_in_transmi.source_quote: The technological latency of the end-system in transmission should be bounded and lower than 150 μs + frame delay.

frame_processing_rate.value: Process received frames at full frame rate of the medium
frame_processing_rate.test_hint: Send frames at maximum rate and check if the system can process them without dropping.
frame_processing_rate.source_quote: Process received frames at full frame rate of the medium and appropriate (selected) frames are made available to the partition at full frame rate of the medium.

maximum_allowed_jitter.test_hint: Introduce variable delays to exceed 500 μs jitter and observe if the system flags the issue.
maximum_allowed_jitter.source_quote: In all cases, the jitter is bounded at 500μs to limit the impact on determinism for the whole network.

wire_speed_capability.value: End System should handle back-to-back frames at wire speed.
wire_speed_capability.test_hint: Send back-to-back frames at maximum rate and verify if the End System can process them without loss.
wire_speed_capability.source_quote: The maximum throughput ("wire speed") corresponds to back-to-back frames.

Error Handling.buffer_overflow_handling_in_transmission: send error indication and discard frame

Filtering and Policing.frame_filtering_function: Frames must be filtered based on predefined criteria to ensure only valid frames are processed.

do_not_exceed_mms_s.test_hint: Send a datagram larger than MMS_S and observe if it is rejected or fragmented.
do_not_exceed_mms_s.source_quote: A host that does not implement local fragmentation MUST ensure that the transport layer (for TCP) or the application layer (for UDP) obtains MMS_S from the IP layer and does not send a datagram exceed

Frame Validation.frame_forwarding_on_valid_crc: Forward frame if FCS and CRC are valid; discard if not

discard_frames_with_non_integral_octet_s.value: discard if not an integral number of octets
discard_frames_with_non_integral_octet_s.test_hint: Generate frames with sizes that are not whole numbers of octets to see if they are discarded.
discard_frames_with_non_integral_octet_s.source_quote: The switch should discard incoming frames having an Ethernet frame size that is not an integral number of octets (alignment errors).

discard_frames_smaller_than_minimum_size.test_hint: Send frames smaller than the allowed Smin for a VL to test if they are discarded.
discard_frames_smaller_than_minimum_size.source_quote: The switch should also discard incoming frames which total Ethernet line size is smaller than the minimum size (Smin) allowed for the relevant VL.

discard_frames_with_erroneous_mac_destin.value: discard if MAC destination address has erroneous 32-bit constant field
discard_frames_with_erroneous_mac_destin.test_hint: Send frames with incorrect MAC destination addresses to see if they are discarded.
discard_frames_with_erroneous_mac_destin.source_quote: The switch should discard incoming frames with a MAC destination address that has an erroneous 32-bit constant field.

discard_frames_with_disallowed_vl_id.value: discard if VL id is not allowed on the incoming port
discard_frames_with_disallowed_vl_id.test_hint: Send frames with VL ids that are not configured for the incoming port to test if they are discarded.
discard_frames_with_disallowed_vl_id.source_quote: The switch should discard incoming frames for which the VL id is not allowed on the incoming port.

ICMP Handling.echo_reply_source_address: The IP source address in an ICMP Echo Reply MUST be the same as the specific-destination address of the corresponding ICMP Echo Request message.
ICMP Handling.echo_reply_data_integrity: Data received in an ICMP Echo Request MUST be entirely included in the resulting Echo Reply.
ICMP Handling.multicast_echo_request_discard_allowance: An ICMP Echo Request destined to an IP broadcast or IP multicast address MAY be silently discarded.
ICMP Handling.echo_reply_forwarding_requirement: Echo Reply messages MUST be passed to the ICMP user interface, unless the corresponding Echo Request originated in the IP layer.

source_quench_handling.test_hint: Test by sending a Source Quench message and observing TCP behavior.
source_quench_handling.source_quote: TCP MUST react to a Source Quench by slowing transmission on the connection.

echo_server_implementation.value: Every host MUST implement an ICMP Echo server function that receives Echo Requests and sends corresponding Echo Replies.
echo_server_implementation.test_hint: Test by sending ICMP Echo Requests to a host and verifying that it sends back Echo Replies.
echo_server_implementation.source_quote: Every host MUST implement an ICMP Echo server function that receives Echo Requests and sends corresponding Echo Replies.

reverse_source_route_for_echo_reply.value: If a Source Route option is received in an ICMP Echo Request, the return route MUST be reversed and used as a Source Route option for the Echo Reply message.
reverse_source_route_for_echo_reply.test_hint: Send Echo Requests with Source Route options and verify that Echo Replies use the reversed route.
reverse_source_route_for_echo_reply.source_quote: If a Source Route option is received in an ICMP Echo Request, the return route MUST be reversed and used as a Source Route option for the Echo Reply message.

Integrity.ordinal_integrity: AFDX networks maintain the order of frames as they are transmitted and received.

Interface.full_access_to_ip_mechanisms: The interface between the IP layer and the transport layer must provide full access to all the mechanisms of the IP layer, including options, Type-of-Service, and Time-to-Live.

MAC Addressing.mac_destination_address_format: xxxx xx11 xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx

Message Structure.implicit_message_structure: Implicit messages have no format overhead associated with them.

Multihoming.silently_discard_datagram_on_wrong_inter: Silently discard if destination address does not match receiving interface

interoperable_functional_elements: Data link: MAC, VL addressing concept
Network application layers: Sampling, Queuing, SAP, TFTP and SNMP

Packet Handling.packet_fragmentation: Whenever a UDP datagram is too long to fit in a packet, it is broken into fragments.

maximum_network_transit_delay_guarantee.value: maximum network transit delay must be guaranteed for each transmission
maximum_network_transit_delay_guarantee.test_hint: Generate traffic loads that could cause transit delays to exceed guaranteed maximums
maximum_network_transit_delay_guarantee.source_quote: Each network transmission request must be serviced regardless of the data type and a maximum network transit delay (also called end-to-end latency) must be guaranteed.

guaranteed_bandwidth_requirement.value: guaranteed service must provide constant bandwidth at link level
guaranteed_bandwidth_requirement.test_hint: Create conditions where bandwidth allocation varies or is not guaranteed

Redundancy Management.first_valid_wins_policy: First frame with next valid sequence number is accepted; duplicates are discarded.
Redundancy Management.handling_abnormal_frames: Abnormal frames are not forwarded to partition.
Redundancy Management.skewmax_parameter: SkewMax value must be provided by system integrator per VL based on network topology
Redundancy Management.increasing_rsn_order: Frames should be forwarded in an increasing RSN order
Redundancy Management.skewmax_exceeded_acceptance: If skew max is exceeded, accept the next frame regardless of sequence number
Redundancy Management.in_sequence_forwarding: Forward only in-sequence frames, loss of one frame may lead to loss of its copy

handling_frame_loss.value: Frame from redundant network is accepted if one is lost.
handling_frame_loss.test_hint: Simulate loss of frames on one network and ensure frames from the redundant network are accepted.
handling_frame_loss.source_quote: Redundancy management result: The frame arriving on the B Network is accepted.

first_win_redundancy_delivery.value: Deliver the first of the redundant frames received
first_win_redundancy_delivery.test_hint: Send multiple redundant frames and verify that only the first received is delivered.
first_win_redundancy_delivery.source_quote: When redundancy management is active, it should deliver the first of the redundant frames received.

reset_tolerance.value: Reset of any equipment should not affect redundancy management
reset_tolerance.test_hint: Perform a reset on network devices and ensure redundancy management continues unaffected.
reset_tolerance.source_quote: Reset of any equipment involved in the communication (transmitting End system, receiving End system or the AFDX switch) should not affect this property.

dual_network_transmission.value: In default mode each frame is sent across both of two networks
dual_network_transmission.test_hint: Send frames on only one network instead of both networks to violate redundancy requirement
dual_network_transmission.source_quote: In default mode each frame is sent across both of two networks.

duplicate_frame_discard.value: When the second frame is received with this sequence number, it is simply discarded
duplicate_frame_discard.test_hint: Send duplicate frames with same sequence number and verify second frame is discarded
duplicate_frame_discard.source_quote: When the second frame is received with this sequence number, it is simply discarded.

per_vl_redundancy_configuration_capabili.source_quote: On a per VL basis, the ES should be able to send messages on either or both networks. This property should be configurable.

redundant_vl_single_data_delivery_mode.value: ES must be able to receive redundant VL and deliver only one copy of redundant data to partition when RM active
redundant_vl_single_data_delivery_mode.test_hint: Send redundant frames and verify only one copy is delivered to partition when RM is active
redundant_vl_single_data_delivery_mode.source_quote: On a per VL basis, the ES should be able to receive: • A redundant VL and deliver to the partition one of the redundant data (RM active)

redundant_vl_dual_data_delivery_mode.value: ES must be able to receive redundant VL and deliver both copies of redundant data to partition when RM not active
redundant_vl_dual_data_delivery_mode.test_hint: Send redundant frames and verify both copies are delivered to partition when RM is not active
redundant_vl_dual_data_delivery_mode.source_quote: On a per VL basis, the ES should be able to receive: • A redundant VL and deliver to the partition both redundant data (RM not active)

non_redundant_vl_reception_capability.value: ES must be able to receive non-redundant VL on either interface and submit data to partition regardless of RM state
non_redundant_vl_reception_capability.test_hint: Send non-redundant frames on single interface and verify proper delivery regardless of RM configuration
non_redundant_vl_reception_capability.source_quote: On a per VL basis, the ES should be able to receive: • A non redundant VL on either interface and submit data from it to the partition (in this case, RM can be active or not)

first_win_frame_delivery.test_hint: Send redundant frames with different arrival times and verify only the first received is delivered, or send frames out of order to test if later frames are incorrectly accepted
first_win_frame_delivery.source_quote: When redundancy management is active, it should deliver the first of the redundant frames received.

copy_frame_loss_due_to_sequencing.test_hint: Create scenarios where one network is faster than another and verify that late-arriving copies are dropped when the sequence has already advanced
copy_frame_loss_due_to_sequencing.source_quote: As a consequence, in some cases, the loss of one frame on one network could also lead to the loss of its copy.

single_ds_for_single_threaded_concentrat.test_hint: Send frames from single threaded concentrators that incorrectly use multiple DS fields or have inconsistent FS-DS relationships
single_ds_for_single_threaded_concentrat.source_quote: If all labels are concentrated into a single Ethernet frame by a single threaded device, a single DS should be used, and the DS status is reflected by a single FS

multiple_ds_for_partial_failure_scenario.source_quote: If the concentrator device is designed in such a way that a portion of it could fail in some way that causes some labels to be invalid, but a completely legal Ethernet frame is still generated with so

Switch Initialization.configuration_access_on_power_on: Configuration information should be accessible through ARINC 615A on switch power on.

switch_operation.frame_filtering_function_requirement: switches must implement frame filtering functionality
switch_operation.traffic_policing_function_requirement: switches must implement traffic policing functionality

switch_operating_modes.switch_initialization_mode_entry: switch must enter INIT mode after power rise or reset

ops_mode_functions.test_hint: Verify that switches in OPS mode reject frames that violate filtering rules or policing constraints
ops_mode_functions.source_quote: In this mode, the Switch performs operational functions: frame and traffic filtering function, switching function, monitoring function, etc.

passive_mode_communication_restriction.value: in PASSIVE mode, switch only communicates with Network Management Function, all other functions stopped
passive_mode_communication_restriction.test_hint: Send normal traffic frames to a switch in PASSIVE mode and verify they are not forwarded
passive_mode_communication_restriction.source_quote: In PASSIVE MODE, the Switch only offers the capability to communicate with the Network Management Function), all others functions should be stopped

switch_initialization_before_subscribers.value: switches should be operational before their connected subscribers to allow subscriber communication during initialization
switch_initialization_before_subscribers.source_quote: The Switches should be operational before their subscribers (connected LRUs), to allow subscribers to communicate via AFDX during their own initialization phase

fault_indicator_state_during_initializat.value: during INIT mode, Fault/Healthy indicator must stay in Fault state
fault_indicator_state_during_initializat.test_hint: Monitor switch health indicators during initialization to verify they remain in fault state
fault_indicator_state_during_initializat.source_quote: During INIT, the Fault/Healthy indicator should stay in the Fault state

Switching.max_delay_for_frame_transmission: max delay = time between arrival of last bit on input port and exit of last bit on output port

TCP Window Management.window_size_as_unsigned_number: Window size must be treated as an unsigned number

TCP Urgent Data.urgent_pointer_points_to_last_octet: The urgent pointer points to the sequence number of the LAST octet

bounded_arrival_distribution.test_hint: Introduce frames with varying intervals to check if the network maintains bounded latency.
bounded_arrival_distribution.source_quote: frame delivery follows a bounded arrival distribution.

Traffic Policing.frame_based_frame_acceptance: If Frame ACi is greater than S i max, the frame is accepted and Frame ACi is debited by S i max

byte_based_traffic_policing.source_quote: The byte-based traffic policing filters out the VL in terms of bandwidth usage expressed in bits per second

Virtual Link.single_source_per_virtual_link: Only one End System within the Avionics network should be the source of any one VL
Virtual Link.maintain_data_ordering: The End System should maintain the ordering of data as delivered by a partition, for both transmission and reception.

dedicated_maximum_bandwidth_per_vl.value: Each Virtual Link has a dedicated maximum bandwidth allocated by the System Integrator.
dedicated_maximum_bandwidth_per_vl.test_hint: Configure a VL with excessive bandwidth usage and observe if other VLs are affected or if the network enforces bandwidth limits.
dedicated_maximum_bandwidth_per_vl.source_quote: Each Virtual Link has a dedicated maximum bandwidth. This bandwidth is allocated by the System Integrator.

afdx_communication_port_transmission_lin.value: In transmission, an AFDX Communication Port should only be linked to a single set of UDP port source, IP source, VL (MAC destination), IP destination and UDP destination.
afdx_communication_port_transmission_lin.test_hint: Attempt to configure an AFDX Communication Port with multiple sets of transmission parameters.
afdx_communication_port_transmission_lin.source_quote: In transmission, an AFDX Communication Port should only be linked to a single set UDP port source, IP source, VL (MAC destination), IP destination and UDP destination.

retransmit_address_mask_request.value: MUST retransmit a small number of times if no immediate reply
retransmit_address_mask_request.test_hint: Do not send an Address Mask Reply and observe if the system retransmits the request a limited number of times.
retransmit_address_mask_request.source_quote: When method 3, it MUST retransmit this message a small number of times if it does not receive an immediate Address Mask Reply.

assume_default_mask.value: SHOULD assume a mask appropriate for the address class until a reply is received
assume_default_mask.test_hint: Do not send an Address Mask Reply and check if the system assumes a default mask based on the IP address class.
assume_default_mask.source_quote: When method 3, until it has received an Address Mask Reply, the host SHOULD assume a mask appropriate for the address class of the IP address.

update_address_mask_from_first_reply.value: MUST use the first received Address Mask Reply to set the address mask
update_address_mask_from_first_reply.test_hint: Send multiple Address Mask Replies and verify that only the first one is used to set the address mask.
update_address_mask_from_first_reply.source_quote: When method 3, the first Address Mask Reply message received MUST be used to set the address mask corresponding to the particular local IP address.

unauthorized_address_mask_reply.value: MUST NOT send an Address Mask Reply unless authorized
unauthorized_address_mask_reply.test_hint: Attempt to send an Address Mask Reply without being configured as an authoritative agent and check if it is sent.
unauthorized_address_mask_reply.source_quote: A system MUST NOT send an Address Mask Reply unless it is an authoritative agent for address masks.

source_address_ownership_requirement.test_hint: Configure an end system to send datagrams with source addresses that are not its own, or use broadcast/multicast addresses as source addresses
source_address_ownership_requirement.source_quote: When a host sends any datagram, the IP source address MUST be one of its own IP addresses (but not a broadcast or multicast address).

destination_address_filtering.test_hint: Send datagrams to an end system with destination addresses that do not belong to that end system and verify they are silently discarded
destination_address_filtering.source_quote: A host MUST silently discard an incoming datagram that is not destined for the host.

ip_address_class_a_private_format.test_hint: Generate frames with IP addresses that do not conform to the Class A private address format (not starting with 10.x.x.x)

source_address_validation.test_hint: Send IP datagrams with invalid source addresses (0.0.0.0, 127.x.x.x, broadcast addresses, multicast addresses) to verify they are rejected
source_address_validation.source_quote: a datagram whose source address does not define a single host -- e.g., a zero address, a loopback address, a broadcast address, a multicast address, or a Class address.

static_addressing_for_intra_afdx_message.value: addressing is statically defined for each message
static_addressing_for_intra_afdx_message.test_hint: Send frames with dynamically changing addresses to verify system rejects non-statically configured addressing
static_addressing_for_intra_afdx_message.source_quote: The principal characteristic of Intra-AFDX communication is the fact that for each message, the addressing is statically defined.

bidirectional_sap_communication_requires.value: two SAPs should be used for bidirectional communication (one Tx, one Rx) with two quintuplets defined
bidirectional_sap_communication_requires.test_hint: Test bidirectional communication with single SAP to verify it fails or requires proper two-SAP configuration
bidirectional_sap_communication_requires.source_quote: To obtain a bi-directional communication, two SAPs should be used (e.g.: SAP 30 000 Tx and SAP 30 000 Rx). In this case, two quintuplets are defined, one for each direction of communication.

bidirectional_afdx_communication_require.value: bidirectional communication ports should be used in queuing mode
bidirectional_afdx_communication_require.test_hint: Test bidirectional communication in sampling mode to verify it fails or behaves incorrectly without queuing mode
bidirectional_afdx_communication_require.source_quote: For a bi-directional communication, the ports should be used in queuing mode.

afdx_transmission_port_quintuplet_unique.test_hint: Attempt to bind multiple quintuplets to a single AFDX transmission port or bind one quintuplet to multiple transmission ports
afdx_transmission_port_quintuplet_unique.source_quote: In transmission, there is only one link between "AFDX Communication port" and the quintuplet (UDP Source Port, Source IP, destination Mac, destination IP, UDP destination port).

afdx_reception_port_quintuplet_uniquenes.source_quote: In reception, there is only one link between "AFDX Communication port" and the quintuplet (UDP Source Port, Source IP, destination Mac, destination IP, UDP destination port).

afdx_transmission_port_parameter_set_bin.source_quote: In transmission, an AFDX Communication Port should only be linked to a single set UDP port source, IP source, VL (MAC destination), IP destination and UDP destination.

afdx_reception_port_parameter_set_bindin.value: AFDX Communication Port linked to single set (unique UDP port destination, IP destination, VL (MAC destination)) plus Ethernet physical interface if redundancy management disabled
afdx_reception_port_parameter_set_bindin.test_hint: Configure an AFDX reception port with multiple different destination parameter sets or incorrect Ethernet interface bindings
afdx_reception_port_parameter_set_bindin.source_quote: In reception, an AFDX Communication Port should only be linked to a single set (unique UDP port destination, IP destination, VL (MAC destination)) and additionally to the Ethernet physical interface i

bandwidth_allocation_for_maximum_message.value: bandwidth allocated for maximum size message cannot be used by other flows
bandwidth_allocation_for_maximum_message.test_hint: Attempt to use bandwidth allocated to one Virtual Link for traffic from another Virtual Link to test bandwidth isolation
bandwidth_allocation_for_maximum_message.source_quote: The bandwidth has been allocated to this data flow for the maximum size the message can be, and is not useable by any other flow. It is therefore not wasted.

reserved_word_alignment.value: Must be aligned on a 32-bit boundary

reserved_word_alignment.source_quote: The Reserved word at the beginning of the message should be aligned on a 32-bit boundary.

functional_status_set_alignment.test_hint: Create messages where Functional Status Sets are not aligned on 32-bit boundaries to test if the network detects misalignment.
functional_status_set_alignment.source_quote: Functional Status Sets should also be aligned on 32-bit boundaries throughout the message.

reject_invalid_remote_ip_address.value: MUST reject as an error a local OPEN call for an invalid remote IP address (e.g., a broadcast or multicast address).
reject_invalid_remote_ip_address.test_hint: Attempt to open a connection using a broadcast or multicast IP address and verify that it is rejected.
reject_invalid_remote_ip_address.source_quote: A TCP implementation MUST reject as an error a local OPEN call for an invalid remote IP address (e.g., a broadcast or multicast address).

time_wait_state_duration.test_hint: Close a connection actively and verify that it remains in TIME-WAIT state for twice the maximum segment lifetime.
time_wait_state_duration.source_quote: When a connection is closed actively, it MUST linger in TIME-WAIT state for a time 2xMSL.

default_configuration_usage_rule.test_hint: Test switch behavior during different initialization states to verify correct configuration file selection
default_configuration_usage_rule.source_quote: The Default_Configuration_File, corresponding to the resident configuration, that is used when the Switch is empty (no field loadable software yet loaded) or when the Switch is being dataloaded (in bo

operational_configuration_file_uniquenes.test_hint: Load different OPS configuration files in switches within the same network to test if inconsistencies are detected or cause forwarding errors
operational_configuration_file_uniquenes.source_quote: The same OPS_Configuration_File (same P/N) is loaded in all the Switches of the Avionics Data Communications Network.

position_based_configuration_table_acces.test_hint: Configure switch to access configuration tables for different positions to test if access control is properly enforced
position_based_configuration_table_acces.source_quote: Depending of its current position, acquired by pin programming, the Switch only has access to the dedicated table of the OPS_Configuration_File.

transfer_syntax_translation.value: Messages must be translated from abstract syntax to transfer syntax before transmission and from transfer syntax to abstract syntax upon reception.

transfer_syntax_translation.source_quote: The message is forwarded through the network to one or more destination computers where another translation is performed from the transfer syntax to the abstract syntax before the message is passed to

message_encapsulation.source_quote: To be transmitted end-to-end through the AFDX, a message must be encapsulated inside an IP datagram.

vl_account_sharing_configuration.value: account can be shared or not shared
vl_account_sharing_configuration.test_hint: Configure multiple VLs to use the same account when sharing is disabled, or violate account bandwidth limits
vl_account_sharing_configuration.source_quote: ACcount (ACi) [specifying if this account is shared or not]

vl_maximum_ethernet_frame_size.value: maximum allowed total ethernet line size per VL
vl_maximum_ethernet_frame_size.test_hint: Send frames larger than the configured Smax for a VL
vl_maximum_ethernet_frame_size.source_quote: Maximum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (Smax)

vl_minimum_ethernet_frame_size.value: minimum allowed total ethernet line size per VL
vl_minimum_ethernet_frame_size.test_hint: Send frames smaller than the configured Smin for a VL
vl_minimum_ethernet_frame_size.source_quote: Minimum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (Smin)

port_maximum_delay_constraint.value: per-port maximum delay limit must be enforced
port_maximum_delay_constraint.test_hint: Generate traffic patterns that cause port delays to exceed the configured maximum

low_priority_vl_output_buffer_size.value: per-port output buffer size for low priority VLs must be configured
low_priority_vl_output_buffer_size.test_hint: Send bursts of low priority traffic that exceed the configured buffer size
low_priority_vl_output_buffer_size.source_quote: Output Buffer Size for Low Priority VLs

high_priority_vl_output_buffer_size.value: per-port output buffer size for high priority VLs must be configured
high_priority_vl_output_buffer_size.test_hint: Send bursts of high priority traffic that exceed the configured buffer size
high_priority_vl_output_buffer_size.source_quote: Output Buffer Size for High Priority VLs

pin_programming_read_timing.value: Hardware program pins should be read during INIT mode only if Switch_Ground_Condition is true and before Safety Test
pin_programming_read_timing.test_hint: Send initialization commands when Switch_Ground_Condition is false or attempt to read pins after Safety Test
pin_programming_read_timing.source_quote: Hardware program pins should be read during the initialization (INIT mode) of the SWITCH only if the Switch_Ground_Condition is true and before performing the Safety Test (if any).

pin_programming_flight_behavior.value: When Switch_Ground_Condition is false, hardware program pins should not be read and switch should use last memorized values
pin_programming_flight_behavior.test_hint: Force switch to read pin programming when Switch_Ground_Condition is false
pin_programming_flight_behavior.source_quote: When the Switch_Ground_Condition is false, hardware program pins should not be read. The Switch should use the last memorized values.

buffer_priority_balance.value: Output port buffer capacity must be balanced between high and low priority frames
buffer_priority_balance.test_hint: Fill output buffer with only high priority or only low priority frames and verify switch maintains proper priority balance
buffer_priority_balance.source_quote: Each output port of the switch should be able to buffer at least 512 frames (balanced between high and low priority).

ops_mode_normal_functions_requirement.value: Switch must perform frames filtering, traffic policing, switching function, and end system function using activated OPS_Configuration_File data
ops_mode_normal_functions_requirement.test_hint: Send frames when switch is in OPS mode but with invalid OPS_Configuration_File or when switch is not properly filtering/policing according to configuration
ops_mode_normal_functions_requirement.source_quote: In OPS, the Switch should perform its normal functions (frames filtering and Traffic policing functions, Switching function, End System function) exclusively relying upon the data contained in the act

dl_mode_end_system_function_configuratio.value: Switch must perform End System function using Default_Configuration_Table data exclusively
dl_mode_end_system_function_configuratio.test_hint: Send frames to switch in DL mode that require OPS_Configuration_File data instead of Default_Configuration_Table data
dl_mode_end_system_function_configuratio.source_quote: In DL Mode, the Switch should perform its End System function exclusively relying upon the data contained in its resident configuration table: Default_Configuration_Table.

passive_mode_switch_functions_disabled.value: All switch functions must be stopped and switch must remain silent
passive_mode_switch_functions_disabled.test_hint: Send frames to switch in PASSIVE mode and verify it does not forward, filter, or police them
passive_mode_switch_functions_disabled.source_quote: In PASSIVE Mode, the functions of the Switch should be stopped and the switch should keep silent.

passive_mode_network_management_communic.value: Must maintain capability to communicate with Network Management Function using default VLs unless pin programming parity error
passive_mode_network_management_communic.test_hint: Send network management frames to switch in PASSIVE mode and verify communication works on default VLs
passive_mode_network_management_communic.source_quote: Nevertheless, the capability to communicate with the Network Management Function should be maintained except if the passive state results from an erroneous parity of the pin programming discretes.

quiet_mode_frame_forwarding_prohibition.value: Switch must not forward frames and must remain quiet (no message generation)
quiet_mode_frame_forwarding_prohibition.test_hint: Send frames through switch in QUIET mode and verify no forwarding or message generation occurs
quiet_mode_frame_forwarding_prohibition.source_quote: The quiet mode ensures that the switch will not forward frames and will remain quiet (not try to generate a message).

delayed_ack_timing.test_hint: Test by delaying ACKs beyond 0.5 seconds and observe if the network reacts to the delay.
delayed_ack_timing.source_quote: The delay MUST be less than 0.5 seconds.

ack_every_second_full_size_segment.value: In a stream of full-sized segments, there should be an ACK for at least every second segment
ack_every_second_full_size_segment.test_hint: Test by sending multiple full-sized segments without sending ACKs for every second segment.
ack_every_second_full_size_segment.source_quote: In a stream of full-sized segments there SHOULD be an ACK for at least every second segment.

frame_sequencing_for_simultaneous_recept.value: simultaneous frames must be sequenced for re-transmission
frame_sequencing_for_simultaneous_recept.test_hint: Send simultaneous frames to a switch and verify they are properly sequenced rather than dropped or corrupted
frame_sequencing_for_simultaneous_recept.source_quote: Simultaneous reception of frames from ESa and ESb at the switch will be dealt with by sequencing the two frames for re-transmission to ES c

switch_forwarding_based_on_mac_destinati.value: forwarding decision based on MAC destination field of received frames
switch_forwarding_based_on_mac_destinati.test_hint: Send frames with different MAC destinations to verify switch forwards to correct output ports according to forwarding table
switch_forwarding_based_on_mac_destinati.source_quote: Switch Forwarding is defined in Table 3-2.

high_priority_transmission_precedence.test_hint: Queue both high and low priority frames and verify high priority frames are transmitted first
high_priority_transmission_precedence.source_quote: For each output port, frames with a priority set to high should be sent prior to the one set to low.

frame_filtering_and_policing_order.value: frames must arrive at Filtering & Policing function before Switching function
frame_filtering_and_policing_order.source_quote: All frames arrive at the switch in the Filtering & Policing function stage where they are filtered in various steps that apply rules about frame integrity, frame length, traffic budget and acceptable

wire_speed_filtering_capability.value: Switch port should filter frames of any valid size arriving at wire speed
wire_speed_filtering_capability.test_hint: Send frames of various sizes at wire speed and verify filtering performance
wire_speed_filtering_capability.source_quote: Each switch port should be able to filter frames of any valid size that are arriving at wire speed.

wire_speed_relaying_capability.value: Switch should relay all incoming frames not rejected by filtering and policing at wire speed for deterministic configurations
wire_speed_relaying_capability.test_hint: Send high volumes of frames that pass filtering and policing and verify relaying at wire speed
wire_speed_relaying_capability.source_quote: Given a deterministic configuration, the switch should be able to relay all incoming frames that are not rejected by filtering and policing, at wire speed and whatever their size.

mac_layer_wire_speed_transmission.value: MAC layer must transmit frames at wire speed
mac_layer_wire_speed_transmission.test_hint: Generate burst traffic at wire speed and verify switch can maintain transmission rate without frame drops or delays
mac_layer_wire_speed_transmission.source_quote: The MAC layer of each switch output port should be able to transmit frames at wire speed.

ip_source_address_request.value: must ask IP layer to select local IP address for SYN if necessary
ip_source_address_request.test_hint: Monitor interactions between TCP and IP layers during SYN transmission to verify proper address selection requests
ip_source_address_request.source_quote: The TCP MUST ask the IP layer to select a local IP.

consistent_local_address_usage.value: must use same local address as previous segments on existing connection
consistent_local_address_usage.test_hint: Send segments with different source addresses on an established connection to verify rejection or correction
consistent_local_address_usage.source_quote: At all other times, a previous segment has either been sent Or received on this connection, and TCP MUST use the same local address is used that was used in those previous segments.

reject_broadcast/multicast_open.value: must reject open call for invalid remote IP address (broadcast or multicast)
reject_broadcast/multicast_open.test_hint: Attempt to open TCP connections to broadcast and multicast addresses and verify they are rejected with error
reject_broadcast/multicast_open.source_quote: A TCP implementation MUST reject as an error a local OPEN call for an invalid remote IP address (e.g., a broadcast or multicast address).

discard_broadcast/multicast_syn.value: must silently discard incoming SYN addressed to broadcast or multicast address
discard_broadcast/multicast_syn.test_hint: Send SYN packets to broadcast and multicast addresses and verify they are silently discarded without response
discard_broadcast/multicast_syn.source_quote: A TCP implementation MUST silently discard an incoming SYN segment that is addressed to a broadcast or multicast address.

tcp_data_aggregation_permission.test_hint: Send multiple TCP segments without PUSH flag set to test aggregation behavior and timing
tcp_data_aggregation_permission.source_quote: When an application issues a series of SEND calls without setting the PUSH flag, the TCP MAY aggregate the data internally without sending it. Similarly, when a series of Segments is received without

tcp_push_flag_requirement_for_last_segme.test_hint: Send TCP segments where the last segment in a sequence lacks the PUSH bit to test compliance enforcement
tcp_push_flag_requirement_for_last_segme.source_quote: MUST set the PSH bit in the last buffered segment (i.e., when there is no more queued data to be sent).

tcp_maximum_segment_size_requirement.test_hint: Send TCP segments that are artificially small when larger segments would be possible to test optimization compliance
tcp_maximum_segment_size_requirement.source_quote: However, a TCP SHOULD send a maximum-sized segment whenever possible, to improve performance

clock_driven_isn_selection_requirement.test_hint: Monitor ISN values across multiple connections to verify they follow clock-driven selection algorithm
clock_driven_isn_selection_requirement.source_quote: A TCP MUST use the specified clock-driven selection of initial sequence numbers.

simultaneous_open_support.test_hint: Send SYN packets from both ends simultaneously to verify proper handling of simultaneous connection establishment
simultaneous_open_support.source_quote: A TCP MUST support simultaneous open attempts.

syn_received_state_tracking.value: must track whether connection reached SYN_RCVD via passive or active open
syn_received_state_tracking.test_hint: Establish connections via both passive and active opens, then verify the implementation can distinguish between them in SYN_RCVD state
syn_received_state_tracking.source_quote: TCP implementation MUST keep track of whether a connection has reached SYN_RCVD state as the result of a passive OPEN or an active OPEN.

passive_open_isolation.value: passive open must not affect previously created connection records
passive_open_isolation.test_hint: Create multiple passive opens on the same port and verify existing connection records remain unaffected
passive_open_isolation.source_quote: Every passive OPEN call it MUST NOT affect any previously created connection record.

concurrent_listen_support.value: must allow listening on port while connection block in SYN-SENT or SYN-RECEIVED state exists
concurrent_listen_support.test_hint: Establish a connection in SYN-SENT state, then attempt to create a LISTEN on the same port to verify concurrent operation
concurrent_listen_support.source_quote: A TCP that supports multiple concurrent users MUST provide an OPEN call that will functionally allow an application to LISTEN on a port while a connection block with the same local port is in SYN-SENT

rst_data_allowance.value: should allow received RST segment to include data
rst_data_allowance.test_hint: Send RST segments with data payload and verify they are processed correctly
rst_data_allowance.source_quote: A TCP SHOULD allow a received RST segment to include data.

application_close_notification.value: must inform application whether connection closed normally or was aborted
application_close_notification.test_hint: Monitor application notifications when connections are closed normally vs. aborted to verify proper status reporting
application_close_notification.source_quote: If a TCP connection is closed by the remote site, the local application MUST be informed whether it closed normally or was aborted.

rst_on_data_loss.value: should send RST when CLOSE called with pending data or new data received after CLOSE
rst_on_data_loss.test_hint: Call CLOSE with pending receive data or send data after CLOSE to verify RST generation indicating data loss
rst_on_data_loss.source_quote: If such a host issues a CLOSE call while received data is still pending in TCP, or if new data is received after CLOSE is called, its TCP SHOULD send a RST to show that data was lost.

time_wait_duration.test_hint: Measure the duration connections remain in TIME-WAIT state and verify it equals 2*MSL
time_wait_duration.source_quote: When a connection is closed actively, it MUST linger in TIME-WAIT state for a time 2xMSL.

window_size_unsigned_integer_constraint.test_hint: Send TCP segments with window size field set to values that would be negative if interpreted as signed integers
window_size_unsigned_integer_constraint.source_quote: The window size MUST be treated as an unsigned number.

window_shrinking_prohibition.test_hint: Generate TCP segments that advertise progressively smaller window sizes to test window shrinking behavior
window_shrinking_prohibition.source_quote: A TCP receiver SHOULD NOT shrink the window, i.e., move the right window edge to the left.

urgent_pointer_sequence_number_constrain.test_hint: Send TCP segments with urgent pointer values that point to LAST+1 instead of LAST octet
urgent_pointer_sequence_number_constrain.source_quote: The urgent pointer points to the sequence number of the LAST octet (not LAST+1)

unsupported_tcp_option_handling_requirem.test_hint: Include undefined or proprietary TCP options in segments to test error-free ignoring behavior
unsupported_tcp_option_handling_requirem.source_quote: A TCP MUST ignore without error any TCP option it does not implement, assuming that the option has a length field.

illegal_option_length_handling_requireme.test_hint: Send TCP segments with malformed option length fields (e.g., length extending beyond segment boundary)
illegal_option_length_handling_requireme.source_quote: TCP MUST be prepared to handle an illegal option length.

timely_delivery_requirement_for_afdx_net.value: Complete and up to date data must be delivered from source to receiver in a timely fashion
timely_delivery_requirement_for_afdx_net.test_hint: Inject delays or drop frames to test how the network handles violations of timely delivery requirements
timely_delivery_requirement_for_afdx_net.source_quote: Control systems generally, and avionics systems in particular, rely on having complete and up to date data delivered from source to receiver in a timely fashion.

frame_size_minimum_constraint_for_byte_b.test_hint: When byte-based policing is enabled, send frames smaller than the configured Smin for a VL
frame_size_minimum_constraint_for_byte_b.source_quote: Ethernet frame size (S) greater than or equal to Smin, only in case where byte-based traffic policing is used

initial_account_setting.test_hint: This is an initialization rule, not directly testable by frame generation
initial_account_setting.source_quote: Initially, the ACcount for VLi (also called ACi, expressed in bytes) is set to

account_crediting_rate.value: proportional to Smax_i with upper limit of BAGi
account_crediting_rate.test_hint: This is a timing behavior rule that affects policing state, not directly testable by single frame
account_crediting_rate.source_quote: ACi is credited as time elapses, proportionally to S i max with an upper limit of BAGi

frame_size_consistency_for_shared_accoun.value: all VLs in a shared account must have the same smin and smax values
frame_size_consistency_for_shared_accoun.test_hint: Configure different smin or smax values for VLs sharing the same account
frame_size_consistency_for_shared_accoun.source_quote: When one ACi is used by a group of VL, all the VL of this group should have the same BAG and the same minimum (smin) and maximum (smax) total Ethernet line size values.

virtual_link_bandwidth_allocation_formul.test_hint: Generate frames that exceed the calculated bandwidth limit Lmax/TGAP for a Virtual Link
virtual_link_bandwidth_allocation_formul.source_quote: The maximum bandwidth allocated to this VL is: Lmax/T GAP.

exact_bandwidth_regulated_traffic_contro.value: traffic must follow exact bandwidth regulated control to limit bandwidth usage over any arbitrarily small interval
exact_bandwidth_regulated_traffic_contro.test_hint: Send bursts of frames that violate bandwidth limits over small time intervals
exact_bandwidth_regulated_traffic_contro.source_quote: Using exact bandwidth regulated traffic control it is possible to limit the bandwidth usage over any arbitrarily small interval of time.

bounded_frame_delivery_distribution.value: frame delivery must follow a bounded arrival distribution, not Poisson
bounded_frame_delivery_distribution.test_hint: Generate frames with Poisson arrival patterns or unbounded intervals between transmissions
bounded_frame_delivery_distribution.source_quote: the transmitting end-systems are not synchronized, but that frame delivery follows a bounded arrival distribution

bag_frame_rate_limit.value: send no more than one frame in each interval of BAG milliseconds
bag_frame_rate_limit.test_hint: Send multiple frames within a single BAG interval and verify they are regulated
bag_frame_rate_limit.source_quote: On a per VL basis the traffic regulator (traffic shaping function) should shape the flow to send no more than one frame in each interval of BAG milliseconds

bag_value_range.test_hint: Configure BAG values outside the 1-128ms range and verify they are rejected
bag_value_range.source_quote: The Traffic shaping function of the ES should be able to handle BAG values in range 1 ms to 128 ms.

transmission_technological_latency_bound.test_hint: Generate frames and measure transmission latency from last bit of partition data to last bit transmitted - should exceed 150μs to violate rule
transmission_technological_latency_bound.source_quote: The technological latency of the end-system in transmission should be bounded and lower than 150 μs + frame delay.

maximum_jitter_constraint_formula_1.test_hint: Generate traffic patterns that would cause jitter exceeding the calculated bound based on VL frame sizes and bandwidth
maximum_jitter_constraint_formula_1.source_quote: In transmission, the maximum allowed jitter on each VL at the output of the end-system should comply with both of the following formulas: max_jitter ≤ 40 + ∑(Lmax * 8) / Nbw

maximum_jitter_absolute_bound.test_hint: Create traffic conditions that would cause transmission jitter to exceed 500μs on any VL
maximum_jitter_absolute_bound.source_quote: In all cases, the jitter is bounded at 500μs to limit the impact on determinism for the whole network.

default_reception_vl_identifier.test_hint: Attempt to use a different format for the default reception VL identifier.
default_reception_vl_identifier.source_quote: The Switch subscribes by default to one unique reception VL, further called VL (0, position).

vl_bandwidth_and_frame_interval_bounds.value: both bandwidth and frame delivery interval must be bounded for each VL
vl_bandwidth_and_frame_interval_bounds.test_hint: Configure VLs with unbounded bandwidth or frame delivery intervals
vl_bandwidth_and_frame_interval_bounds.source_quote: This is achieved by bounding both the bandwidth and the frame delivery interval for each VL.

vl_bandwidth_isolation.value: available bandwidth on any VL must be unaffected by attempted utilization of other VLs
vl_bandwidth_isolation.test_hint: Saturate one VL with traffic and verify other VLs maintain their allocated bandwidth
vl_bandwidth_isolation.source_quote: The ES should provide logical isolation with respect to available bandwidth among the Virtual Link(s) it supports. Regardless of the attempted utilisation of a VL by one partition, the available Bandw

vl_partition_exclusivity.value: one VL should not be shared by two or more source partitions
vl_partition_exclusivity.test_hint: Configure multiple partitions to share the same VL identifier
vl_partition_exclusivity.source_quote: One Virtual Link should not be shared by two or more source partitions.

default_reception_vl_uniqueness.test_hint: Send frames to multiple default reception VLs or wrong VL identifiers to test if switch properly filters to only its designated VL
default_reception_vl_uniqueness.source_quote: the Switch subscribes by default to one unique reception VL, further called VL (0, position)

default_transmission_vl_uniqueness.test_hint: Configure multiple switches with same transmission VL or invalid VL format to test uniqueness enforcement
default_transmission_vl_uniqueness.source_quote: Each Switch has a unique default transmission VL, further called VL (1, position)
